corruptions.text: Loretta Lynn, the American country singer known for her hit song "Never Can Say Goodbye," has a career spanning over half a century. Her album Here I Am Again, released on October 2, 1972, is considered her last studio album with Decca Records prior to merging with MCA Records in 1973.
